recognize_zh: 中倍率免疫染色：許多大型腫瘤細胞呈細胞膜環狀陽性，同時背景中大量小淋巴球也強陽性，代表這是一個腫瘤細胞與反應性小淋巴球共同表現的淋巴球標記（未標示抗體，可能為 T 細胞或白血球共同標記），用來佐證 ALCL 的淋巴球來源。
features: Diffuse lymphoid infiltrate at intermediate magnification
Large cells with membranous ring-like brown staining and clear cytoplasm
Numerous small lymphocytes with strong dense membranous and cytoplasmic staining
A proportion of large cells are weak or negative
Negative stromal and endothelial nuclei in the background
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node at intermediate power shows a diffuse infiltrate of large atypical cells admixed with small lymphocytes. Many large cells show membranous ring-like positivity, while numerous background small lymphocytes are strongly positive and some large cells are weak or negative. The antibody is not labeled; the pattern indicates a lymphoid-lineage (T-cell or leukocyte) marker shared by tumor cells and reactive small lymphocytes. This supports a hematolymphoid origin of the large cells, consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma in context, but lineage assignment requires the full panel, because ALCL often loses pan-T-cell antigens such as CD3.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are usually negative for CD45 and T-cell markers and are surrounded by positive rosetting T cells rather than forming sheets.
DLBCL large cells stain for B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5) and are negative for T-cell antigens stained in small reactive cells.
Non-hematopoietic tumors are negative for leukocyte and T-cell markers and express cytokeratin or S100/SOX10.
